column1: # Voice lines: the one word list for both the plugin (VoiceLines.java) and
# kind phrase:   a fixed opening, key = its name in VoiceLines
# kind alert:    a whole line for one ActivityAlerts.Type, key = the type
# kind verb:     the activity, key = the Skill
# kind resource: what you were gathering, key = Skill|item name in lower case;
#                several items may share one clip
# kind detail:   a whole line more particular than its alert's, key =
#                SkillingEvents.voiceKey ("CLUE_DROP|hard"); said instead of the alert line
# Each clip is voice/<clip>.wav. Keep the words plain: this ships on the Plugin Hub.
